simple.summary: סָבַךְ (çâbak) means to entwine First listed occurrence: Job 8 17.

definitions.full: H5440. sabak [ סָבַךְ ] verb interweave (|| form to שׂבך q. v.); — Qal Passive participle plural סְבֻכִים סִירִים Nahum 1:10 interwoven (entangled) thorns (compare Da); Gunk ZAW xiii (1893), 235 proposes (after ᵑ7 ᵐ5 Vollers) כְּסוּחִים i.e. cut off, away ( Isa 33:12 ) compare Now; text very dubious Pu`al Imperfect 3masculine plural יְסֻבָּ֑כוּ שָׁרָשָׁיו עַלגַּֿל Job 8:17 are interwoven (in a tangled mass).
